analysis.primary: Best admissible non-STOP full-option goal progress minus actually selected ghost; learned and forced STOP states excluded
controls: primitive count no greater than selected
movement path no longer than selected

purpose: Training-only diagnostic of complete graph actions, with selected sentinels, reversed enumeration and baseline noninterference.
limits: Eight routes across four training scenes, one simulator seed; no learned model or navigation gain claim. Final-decision non-STOP alternatives are inadmissible. Goal distances are analysis-only.
